data.body: MV SYSTEMIC FINDING (affects this ticket's upcoming review). Both Wave-1 reviewers (C11-151, C11-152) hit this and manually reviewed the real range origin/main..HEAD as an own-reviewer fallback. LOAD-BEARING row 6 STILL PENDING: needs an OBSERVED live pi quit+relaunch exact-session resume in a tagged build (pi --session of the UUID matching the newest ~/.pi/agent/sessions/<slug>/<ts>_<uuid>.jsonl, prior history visible) — not just green units — before pr_open.

SERIAL pbxproj heads-up: your worktree is off main@e6edf9513; main is now 60646a3ac (incl #272 + #274 pbxproj changes), so expect a project.pbxproj conflict needing a rebase before auto-merge. Same fix as C11-151: rebase, take main's pbxproj, re-add the new Pi files via the xcodeproj gem, re-verify ref symmetry + c11-logic.

IMPL-TIME DEVIATION (flagged for orchestrator/MV): PiScraper does cwd-SCOPED lookup, not a literal CodexScraper whole-tree mirror. Reason: codex narrows candidates via its wrapper-claim time floor; pi has NO wrapper/hook and thus NO floor — so a whole-tree mirror makes EVERY restore ambiguous (this machine has 17 pi session dirs) -> resume always skips -> pi never positively resumes, failing the 'live pi resumes exact session' acceptance. Fix: when cwd is known, scope the walk to pi's per-cwd slug dir (~/.pi/agent/sessions/<slug>/). Slug encoding mirrors pi's own migrations.js exactly (verified + tested). PiStrategy stays a faithful codex mirror; change is scraper-only, reversible. This supersedes Plan-Review item 4 ('mirror codex / don't expand scope') which rested on a false codex-equivalence. 12/12 PiConversationTests + 8/8 parity green. Now rebuilding tagged for live validation.

COMPLETE — pr_open. PR #275: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/275

Inline-full delegator run done:
- Plan -> plan-review (PASS, art_01KW8ESEKP8S3KWHN4W7HRRHQ3) -> impl -> code-review (own-reviewer fallback, PASS, art_01KW8GDAJ4ZAPS8G1KR3ZPMK5J; headless review was vacuous per the MV LATTICE_ROOT finding) -> validation (PASS, art_01KW8HM7XG1ZS9YGZ1S75HV5TH) -> pr_open.
- Scope delivered: PiScraper + PiStrategy + registration + manifest flag flip (one commit, parity test green).
- OBSERVED live exact-session resume on a tagged build: pi session 019f1116-a8d7-70d5-bc9e-0c91c1050a08 resolved at restore via captured_via=scrape, state=alive -> pi --session '<id>'; restored surface re-rendered the exact prior session.
- IMPL-TIME DEVIATION (flagged): PiScraper does cwd-SCOPED lookup (pi's per-cwd slug dir), not a literal codex whole-tree mirror — required because pi has no wrapper-claim floor; without it every restore is ambiguous->skip and pi never resumes. Documented in plan + PR body + earlier comment. Reversible, scraper-only.
- Rebased onto current main (C11-151 #274 + C11-152 #273 merged); no merge-order dependency. 20/20 logic tests green post-rebase.

Stopping here for orchestrator auto-merge. Not merging myself.

MV adjudication of the flagged IMPL-TIME DEVIATION (PiScraper cwd-scoped lookup vs literal CodexScraper whole-tree mirror): ENDORSED — the deviation is correct and necessary, and it aligns with the SPEC.

Reasoning: (1) The SPEC (docs/agent-exact-resume-plan.md) itself describes pi sessions as ~/.pi/agent/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<ISO-ts>_<uuid>.jsonl — i.e. organized by cwd-slug. Scoping the walk to the current cwd's slug dir is faithful to the actual on-disk model, not an expansion of scope. (2) The plan-review item 4 ('mirror codex / don't expand scope') rested on a false codex-equivalence: codex narrows via a wrapper-claim time floor that pi lacks, so a literal whole-tree mirror leaves every restore ambiguous (the cwd stamp can't disambiguate same-stamped candidates) -> resume always skips -> the load-bearing 'live pi resumes exact session' acceptance (row 6) cannot be met. (3) The change is scraper-only, reversible, PiStrategy stays a faithful codex mirror, and slug encoding was verified against pi's own migrations.js. This is the right call.

NOTE for the record: I have propagated this same finding to C11-154 (omp) — OmpScraper currently does the whole-tree walk WITHOUT cwd-scoping, so omp has the latent ambiguity bug pi just fixed. Flagged on C11-154.

Row 6 status: units + parity GREEN (verified 17/0 then 12/12+8/8 on the amend). The validation artifact (art_01KW8HM7XG1ZS9YGZ1S75HV5TH) is attached but I have not yet been able to read its body to confirm the OBSERVED live pi resume (the actual ses/uuid re-attach with prior history visible). Before this ticket auto-merges, please ensure the PR body or a validation comment states the observed live result explicitly (which UUID resumed, history visible) — that is the load-bearing row-6 evidence. If it's already in the artifact, disregard; I'll confirm at PR-open.
